integrity: All-dimensional claims have analytic proofs with explicit hypotheses; actual finite Euclidean checker is independent corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Only the standard Euclidean zero-sum-coordinate realization of complete-graph root polytopes is addressed. A quantitative hypergeometric-to-normal Berry–Esseen constant and extensions to other graphs are not claimed; unindexed priority remains possible.
title: A hypergeometric surface-area law and asymptotic tangency of complete type-A root polytopes
